
### Blue mussel

#### Summary statistics

```{r, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
if (file.exists("../MCOM25_HARSAT/output/MCoM_2025_10L/tables/{{var}}_mussel_table.csv")){
  read_csv("../MCOM25_HARSAT/output/MCoM_2025_10L/tables/{{var}}_mussel_table.csv") %>%
    kable("latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c(rep("l", 2), rep("r", 14)),
          caption = paste("{{var_name}} in Blue mussel.", tabcap)) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" "=5, "Whole time period"=6, "Last 10 years"=2)) %>% 
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"))
} else
{
  print(paste("../MCOM25_HARSAT/output/MCoM_2025_10L/tables/{{var}}_mussel_table.csv", "is missing"))
  
}
```


#### Station time-series

```{r, fig.width = 4, out.width = "0.33\\textwidth", fig.asp= 1.3, echo = FALSE}
plot_files <- dir("../MCOM25_HARSAT/output/MCoM_2025_10L/figs/") %>% 
  subset(., str_detect(., "MYTI_{{var}}.pdf")) %>% 
  order_figs() %>% 
  paste0("../MCOM25_HARSAT/output/MCoM_2025_10L/figs/", .) %>% 
  subset(., file.exists(.))
knitr::include_graphics(plot_files)
```
